page.notes: The year "LXXVIII" and the day "xxiii" are read from a tight scan and are uncertain; the year may be LXXVIII (1578). The word "tes" below the last line is treated as the catchword and the text ends on "par-". The small dots and marks in both margins are printer's ornaments or stray marks, not text. The Google watermark at the lower right is a digitiser banner and is left out. Long s is rendered as plain s throughout.
